blocks.x: Do you want to talk about the Colonel?

Well, yeah. I don’t know its kind of minutia. Colonel Ranger and his Ranger tone. I don’t know why anybody would be interested in that. After World War II he came with a machine and tried to sell them, I don’t think there is enough guts there.
Well I’ve run into a blank myself.
Are we through, we could be through.
